body:
Adding physical sound and literature commons expands the protocol's civic scope. Claiming these public artifacts as an official Attogram Protectorate provides physical anchors for community stewardship across transit hubs and neighborhoods.
Here is how these two new petitions integrate into the DOI registry:
attogram.017: The Station Piano Acoustic Commons (Stationstuning Protocol)
 * The Concept: Establishing an open, community-led maintenance and tuning protocol for the public transit pianos across Amsterdam (Amsterdam Centraal, Amstel Station, Sloterdijk, and Bijlmer ArenA).
 * Actionable Outcome: Coordinates local tuners, acoustic technicians, and musicians to log piano condition reports, schedule public tunings, and host spontaneous performance jams directly on the attogram.017 thread—ensuring these instruments remain tuned and functional for commuters.
attogram.018: The Free Bookshelf Guild & Protectorate (Minibieb Alliance)
 * The Concept: Declaring every street-side micro-library (minibieb) and public book exchange box in Amsterdam an official Attogram Protectorate.
 * Actionable Outcome: Creates a decentralized steward network. "Protectors" monitor box weatherproofing, swap out damaged stock, repair physical shelves, and log book rotations directly to the attogram.018 DOI thread.
